title: Google and Microsoft sign-in ready
summary: Add optional Google and Microsoft OAuth sign-in without changing roster authorisation or permissions.
changes: The sign-in screen now supports Google and Microsoft alongside the existing email, password and passkey options.
OAuth sessions still pass through the existing approved-email checks and Row Level Security before roster data can open.
Microsoft requests only the email scope needed for roster identity checks, while provider secrets stay in Supabase rather than browser code.
Roster calculations, staffing, allocations, Pager, Reliever and database permissions remain unchanged.
